name: Yuru-chara×Maou no Love Paradox
original_name: ゆるキャラ×魔王の恋愛パラドックス
source:
The main character dies in the human world and gets reborn as a mascot in the demon world... Will she be able to go back to being human?!

[Edited from [url=https://booth.pm/en/items/3631484]BOOTH[/url]]
translation:
女主角在人类世界死去，转生后竟然成了魔界的吉祥物……她还能变回人类吗？！
